# Welcome

Welcome to the Precision Teaching training study.

Please review the timeline and complete each weekly activity as scheduled.

## Study Timeline

| Week | Activities |
|---|---|
| Week 1 | Pretest and Quiz |
| Weeks 2–4 | No study activities |
| Week 5 | Posttest and Quiz |

## FAQ

### Do I need to complete activities during Weeks 2–4?

No. Participants in this condition only complete activities during Week 1 and Week 5.

### What should I do if a link does not work?
Contact the research team by email precisionteaching5weeks@gmail.com 

### How long will this study last?
Approximately 5 weeks.
